title: Carlow — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Carlow: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Carlow has a population of 25,000. A historic market town in southeastern Ireland, known for Carlow Castle, the Brownshill Dolmen, and a growing commuter population serving Dublin. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Sunshine is limited, with about 47 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
